authority: Demo acceptance contract derived from existing versioned rules and DEMO_DATA_SPEC.md; not human-approved production policy.
policy: Keep thresholds 30/60 and existing weights. New account alone and shared address alone do not imply high risk. Freeze expected results independently of evaluator output.

S02.reason: Large COD plus new account: 15+10=25, below medium threshold 30; plan does not require High.

S03.reason: Repeated verified simulated buyer failures across linked identities; score capped at 100.

S04.reason: Multiple real checkout times across shops plus simulated linked buyer-failure history.

S05.reason: Dorm address shared but deliveries good; no buyer-abuse evidence.

S06.reason: Verified simulated seller fault must not count as buyer abuse.

X01.reason: One checkout split across shops must not trigger velocity.

X04.reason: Clean new buyer with no adverse history.
